entries.official_row: Reviewer REPAIR-D4-PROMPT sections 1–2 plus planner settlement; not an additional owner decision or published Namibian rule.
entries.departure: Once-only eligibility recorded at first use; ineligible data stay canonical in all later parts. For each eligible datum mark all gross evidence first, then deduct from its first earned A/B in question/criterion order, including a later part. No deduction only when no A/B is earned on that datum anywhere. Gross dependencies/www/DM remain satisfied after the net penalty. Eligible F.T. overrides not-F.T./c.a.o.; correct working, named errors and OD-1 remain. An A/B is on a datum when it lies in the datum's first-use part or a later part whose working uses the misread data, whether or not that criterion's own value changes. Eligibility is judged at first use for the connected question. Eligible follow-through never overrides MR09 (no F.T. into a supplied result) or OD-1 answer-only rules.
entries.rationale: Prevent a free misread when the first-use part earns no accuracy mark and prevent a penalty cascading through dependencies. Designed no-real outcomes are distinguished from destroying a canonical solution. Unit, ordering, eligibility details and ledger require exact-manifest approval.
entries.status: Pending Vitalis approval of the exact manifest; reviewer-prescribed and planner-adopted, not owner-chosen mechanics.
